name: soundcloud-listen-along
description: An unofficial, self-hosted listen-along extension for SoundCloud.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:firefox && npm run validate:manifests
scripts.server:check: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix server test
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run server:check
scripts.release:package: npm run check && npm run build:all && npm run zip && npm run zip:firefox && npm run validate:release
